p0.title: Plush-Lined EVA Clog Slippers
p0.descriptionHtml:
A waffle-textured clog shell with a fluffy plush cuff and lining, easy to slip on around the house.

  • Molded EVA shell, plush faux-fur lining
  • Removable plush liner, slip-on clog shape
  • Textured tread sole

EU sizes 31–44 · Foot length 8–11 in

p1.title: Fleece-Lined Hooded Zip Jacket
p1.descriptionHtml:
A workwear-style zip jacket with a plush-lined hood and a contrast collar, an easy top layer over knits.

  • Polyester shell, plush fleece lining
  • Loose fit, full zip, drawstring hood, zip chest pocket
  • Hip length (about 28–31 in), slant side pockets

Sizes S–3XL · Bust 43–57 in

p2.title: Oversized Metal Cat Eye Sunglasses
p2.descriptionHtml:
Wide cat-eye lenses on a slim gold-tone frame, an easy finishing touch for sunny days and travel.

  • Gold-tone metal frame, acrylic lenses
  • Gradient, mirrored or solid lenses, clear nose pads
  • Oversized cat-eye shape, slim metal temples

One size · Frame width about 6 in

p3.title: Chunky Oversized Square Sunglasses
p3.descriptionHtml:
Bold oversized square frames with flared corners, made for statement sunny-day looks.

  • Glossy plastic (PC) frame and lenses
  • Thick temples with a slim metal accent, gradient or solid lenses
  • Oversized square shape, lenses about 2 in wide and tall

One size · Frame width about 6 in

p4.title: Pointed Cat Eye Sunglasses
p4.descriptionHtml:
Sharp, upswept cat-eye frames in glossy and see-through colors, a retro accent for denim and summer dresses.

  • Plastic (PC) frame, acrylic lenses
  • Solid or see-through frames, gold-tone accent
  • Pointed cat-eye shape, lenses about 2 in wide

One size · Frame width about 6 in

p5.title: Studded Scarf-Neck Poncho Top
p5.descriptionHtml:
A sheer, crinkled poncho top with handkerchief points, a studded hem and a scarf tie that loops at the neck.

  • Lightweight sheer polyester, crinkle texture
  • Relaxed batwing cut, neck scarf tie, metal stud trim
  • Pullover poncho shape with a pointed hem

Sizes XS–L · Length 20–21 in

p6.title: Alphabet Print Crewneck Fleece Sweatshirt
p6.descriptionHtml:
A relaxed crewneck with a playful handwriting-practice print with an apple and pencil, for easy school-day layering.

  • Polyester sweatshirt fleece, brushed inside
  • Loose fit, ribbed crew neck, cuffs and hem
  • Long sleeves, hip length (about 26–29 in)

Sizes S–XXL · Bust 43–51 in

p7.title: Lip Print Fleece Sweatshirt
p7.descriptionHtml:
A bold lip graphic with jewel-toned gold teeth, printed on a loose crewneck with dropped shoulders.

  • Polyester sweatshirt fleece
  • Loose fit, crew neck, ribbed cuffs and hem
  • Long sleeves, hip length (about 26–29 in)

Sizes S–XXL · Bust 43–51 in

p8.title: Sunshine Graphic Fleece Sweatshirt
p8.descriptionHtml:
A retro sun-and-moon graphic with flowers and “Stay Magical” lettering on a relaxed crewneck.

  • Polyester sweatshirt fleece
  • Loose fit, crew neck, ribbed cuffs and hem
  • Long sleeves, hip length (about 26–29 in)

Sizes S–XXL · Bust 43–51 in

p9.title: Color-Block Stripe Rib Cardigan
p9.descriptionHtml:
Red, navy, brown and gray stripes on a fitted rib cardigan with a contrast brown polo collar.

  • Polyester, viscose and spandex rib knit with stretch
  • Slim fit, pointed collar, button front
  • Long sleeves, regular length (about 21–22 in)

Sizes S–L · Bust 29–32 in

p10.title: Double V-Neck Rib Cardigan
p10.descriptionHtml:
A fitted rib cardigan with a layered double V-neckline, so it reads as two pieces in one.

  • Rib knit blend
  • Slim fit, button front, raglan sleeves
  • Long sleeves, regular length (about 21–22 in)

Sizes S–M · Bust 30–31 in

p11.title: Lace-Up Cable Knit Sweater
p11.descriptionHtml:
Allover cable knit with a criss-cross laced keyhole at the neckline, fitted through the body.

  • Polyester cable knit
  • Slim fit, crew neck, laced keyhole front
  • Long sleeves, ribbed cuffs and hem (about 22–23 in long)

Sizes S–M · Bust 29–31 in

p12.title: Stand Collar Chunky Knit Cardigan
p12.descriptionHtml:
A chunky rib cardigan with a high stand collar that buttons off-center, plus button tabs at the shoulders.

  • Viscose and polyester rib knit
  • Loose fit, dropped shoulders, full button front
  • Long sleeves, banded hem (about 22–23 in long)

Sizes S–L · Bust 44–47 in

p13.title: Ribbon Lace Oversized Knit Cardigan
p13.descriptionHtml:
An oversized cream cardigan laced with soft blue ribbon down the front and sleeves, tied in bows at the hem.

  • Acrylic knit
  • Oversized fit, button front, dropped shoulders
  • Long puff sleeves, hip length (about 28–29 in)

Sizes S–XL · Bust 47–51 in

p14.title: Asymmetric Drape Neck Knit Top
p14.descriptionHtml:
A folded drape cuts across the neckline at an angle, with soft gathers at the side waist on a close, fitted knit.

  • Soft rayon and cotton blend knit
  • Slim fit, asymmetric draped neckline, ruched side waist
  • Long sleeves, lettuce-edge hems, length about 20–21 in

Sizes S–L

p15.title: Tie Neck Ruffle Hem Top
p15.descriptionHtml:
A slim strap loops around the neck and falls as a long tie over a crossover V, ending in a ruched, ruffled hem.

  • Stretch rib knit
  • Slim fit, crossover V-neck, ruched side waist
  • Long bell-cuff sleeves, asymmetric ruffle hem, length about 23–24 in

Sizes S–L

p16.title: Scalloped Square Neck Lace Top
p16.descriptionHtml:
Floral lace over a nude lining, finished with a scalloped square neckline and long, slightly flared sheer sleeves.

  • Nylon floral lace with a nude lining in the body
  • Slim fit, square neck with a scalloped lace edge
  • Long sheer lace sleeves, length about 19–20 in

Sizes S–L

p17.title: Lace Panel Sheer Chiffon Blouse
p17.descriptionHtml:
Airy chiffon falls into wide batwing sleeves, with a cream lace V-panel and two ribbon ties down the front.

  • Sheer polyester chiffon with lace trim, no stretch
  • Loose fit, lace V-panel front, ribbon ties
  • Batwing sleeves, gathered cuffs, pointed hem, length about 27–28 in

Sizes XS–L

p18.title: Crossover Rib Waist Top
p18.descriptionHtml:
A crossover V-neck sits above a fitted rib-knit waist panel for a clean empire line and a short, cropped length.

  • Soft rayon blend knit
  • Slim fit, crossover V-neck, rib-knit waist panel
  • Long sleeves with gathered shoulders, cropped length about 18 in

Sizes S–M

p19.title: Strappy One-Shoulder Jersey Top
p19.descriptionHtml:
One bare shoulder with a thin strap on that side and an angled hem give this relaxed long-sleeve tee an easy shape.

  • Soft, lightweight jersey knit
  • Relaxed fit, one-shoulder neckline with a thin strap
  • Long sleeves, asymmetric hem, length about 24–25 in

Sizes S–M · Bust 44–46 in

p20.title: Boat Neck Cropped Pocket Sweatshirt
p20.descriptionHtml:
A wide boat neck, kangaroo pocket and cropped ribbed hem make an easy weekend sweatshirt.

  • Sweatshirt knit with a brushed inside
  • Loose fit, dropped shoulders, wide boat neck, front pocket
  • Long sleeves with ribbed cuffs, cropped length about 23 in

Sizes S–M · Bust 43–44 in

p21.title: Tie-Front Ruffle Lace Top
p21.descriptionHtml:
Rose-pattern lace gathers under a ruffled square neckline with a small front tie, over a nude-lined bust.

  • Stretch lace, 90% polyester and 10% spandex
  • Slim fit, ruffled square neck, gathered bust with tie
  • Sheer long sleeves, lettuce-edge hems, length about 19–20 in

Sizes S–L

p22.title: Ripped Knee Wide-Leg Jeans
p22.descriptionHtml:
Faded denim falls wide from a high waist, with open rips at the knee for a relaxed, lived-in look.

  • Cotton denim, medium weight
  • High waist, zip fly, five pockets, ripped knee
  • Wide straight leg, raw hem, about 41–43 in long

Sizes S–XXL · Waist 28–37 in · Hip 39–48 in

p23.title: Frayed Hem Ripped Ankle Jeans
p23.descriptionHtml:
A cropped skinny jean with shredded rips down the front and a frayed step hem.

  • Cotton-blend stretch denim
  • Button and zip fly, five-pocket style, ripped thighs and knees
  • Skinny leg, ankle length, frayed step hem

Sizes S–XXL · Waist 27–35 in · Hip 37–44 in

p24.title: Contrast Stitch V-Waist Flare Jeans
p24.descriptionHtml:
Deep indigo denim fits close through the hip, then opens into a long flare with white topstitching.

  • Dark wash denim, no stretch
  • V-front waistband, zip fly, five pockets
  • Flare leg, full length (about 41–42 in)

Sizes S–XL · Waist 26–33 in · Hip 35–42 in

p25.title: Shredded Light Wash Skinny Jeans
p25.descriptionHtml:
A cloudy light wash with bold shredded rips down both legs, cut close from hip to ankle.

  • Stretch denim, light faded wash
  • Button and zip fly, curved front seams, five-pocket style
  • Skinny leg, full length (about 39–40 in)

Sizes XS–XXXL · Waist 25–33 in (S–3XL)

p26.title: Fleece-Lined Faux Leather Skinny Pants
p26.descriptionHtml:
Black faux leather with a soft fleece lining, cut as a high-waist skinny pant.

  • PU faux leather outside, fleece-lined inside
  • High waist, zip fly, front patch pockets
  • Skinny leg, ankle zips, about 38–39 in long

Sizes S–XXXL · Waist 25–33 in · Hip 34–42 in

p27.title: High-Waist Stretch Skinny Jeans
p27.descriptionHtml:
A high waist and a smooth, pocket-free front give these stretch skinny jeans a clean line.

  • Stretch denim with plenty of give
  • High waist, button and zip fly, back pockets
  • Skinny leg, full length (about 37–41 in)

Sizes XS–XXL · Waist 22–30 in · Hip 30–38 in

p28.title: Two-Tone Patchwork Skinny Jeans
p28.descriptionHtml:
Light and mid-blue denim meet at a center seam, with ripped knees and frayed hems.

  • Cotton stretch denim
  • Mid rise, zip fly, five pockets, two-tone panels
  • Skinny leg, raw hem, about 38–39 in long

Sizes S–4XL · Waist 25–35 in · Hip 33–43 in
